story.title: OpenAI's TanStack npm Supply Chain Attack Compromised Two Employee Devices
story.summary: OpenAI has confirmed that two employee devices were compromised after malware hidden in poisoned npm packages associated with the TanStack JavaScript ecosystem reached company machines, resulting in the theft of a limited amount of internal credential material. The incident is the latest in a string of software supply chain attacks targeting AI companies and highlights how attackers are using trusted open-source ecosystems as entry points into high-value AI organisations. OpenAI says it has contained the breach and is working with the npm security team.
